item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J01765","case1_error":"Reports unsupported 19 after outlining the correct counting approach; the total should be 17.","case2_error":"Reports unsupported 52 after correct formulas; the result should be 54.","reason":"Both give incorrect final numbers without showing a numerical evaluation that identifies the arithmetic mistake.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J01766","case1_error":"Reduces the required length by 25% instead of accounting for reduced usable length per purchased piece.","case2_error":"Gives unsupported 300 after correct formulas for remaining pages; those formulas yield 200.","reason":"The first writes an erroneous loss relation; the second supplies an incorrect final number after a correct setup.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01767","case1_error":"Subtracts only two duplicate counts, although each shared movie contributes two extra counts; the total is 30.","case2_error":"Adds the senior discount back after correctly subtracting it, undoing the discount.","reason":"Undercorrecting repeated counts and reversing a valid discount are distinct erroneous relations.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01768","case1_error":"Treats 45 training days as 45 weeks, omitting division by five; intermediate rep descriptions also contradict their stated thresholds.","case2_error":"Treats 20% of the contractor's hourly rate as the inspector's total fee; the comparison basis and inspection duration are unspecified.","reason":"The first clearly confuses days with weeks. The inspector payment wording leaves a material ambiguity between comparing total charges and hourly rates.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J01769","case1_error":"Adds weekly kale to doubled two-week vegetable consumption and reports the mixture as a weekly amount.","case2_error":"Uses all 24 hours daily as walking time despite the stated one-hour daily schedule.","reason":"The first combines quantities covering incompatible periods; the second substitutes elapsed time for scheduled activity time.","judgment":"different"}]}
